name: @afora/codegen
description: Generates idiomatic @afora/core TypeScript from an afora.json spec, and extracts the spec back from an application.
author: Alan Reis <alanreisanjo@gmail.com> (https://github.com/Hoyasumii)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun scripts/schema.ts && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/cli.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/add-dts-extensions.ts dist
